title: Deep Learning for Medical Image Analysis
abstract: Deep learning techniques are used for medical image classification and disease detection. Convolutional neural networks provide effective solutions for image analysis.

title: Graph Neural Networks for Social Network Analysis
abstract: Graph neural networks can analyze relationships between users in social networks and identify communities and influential users.

title: Natural Language Processing for Research Papers
abstract: Natural language processing techniques can extract important entities and relationships from scientific research papers.

title: Knowledge Graphs for Scientific Research
abstract: Knowledge graphs represent researchers, papers, topics and relationships to support scientific information discovery.

title: Transformer Models for Text Classification
abstract: Transformer-based models provide powerful methods for text classification and document understanding.

title: Recommendation Systems for Researchers
abstract: Recommendation algorithms can identify related research papers and potential collaborators based on research interests.

title: GraphRAG for Scientific Question Answering
abstract: Graph retrieval combined with language models can improve question answering over scientific research data.

title: Vector Search for Academic Documents
abstract: Vector embeddings enable semantic search and retrieval of research papers based on their meaning.

title: AI Based Patent Analysis
abstract: Artificial intelligence techniques can analyze patents and identify technologies, researchers and related research areas.

title: Research Collaboration Networks
abstract: Collaboration networks can be analyzed using graph algorithms to identify important researchers and potential collaborators.
